# Cover crops and soil carbon in a temperate rotation

Brenner, A., Vogel, K. (2021). *Journal of Synthetic Agronomy* 14(2), 88–101.

## Site description

The trial was established at the Wendelsheim Long-Term Site in Germany. Mean
annual temperature at the site is 9.4 °C. The rotation comprised winter wheat,
spring barley and sugar beet.

Each treatment was replicated four times in a randomised complete block design.
The site has been under reduced tillage since establishment.

## Measurements

Soil organic carbon was measured at two depths at the close of the trial.

| Outcome | Depth (cm) | Value | Unit | SE |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Soil organic carbon | 0–15 | 14.2 | g/kg | 0.6 |
| Soil organic carbon | 15–30 | 9.8 | g/kg | 0.4 |

Values are means across the four replicates.
